**Finding: compliant (RENEWAL).**

Section 13 (p0078) is the sole renewal mechanic and it clears the fallback — indeed it matches the preferred parameters on the two structural terms:

- **Renewal term:** successive **one-year** periods (≤ 12 months).
- **Customer exit:** either party, including Client, may block renewal on **30 days'** written notice before the end of the then-current year — inside both the preferred 30-day and fallback 60-day windows, and far from the 90-day/multi-year walk-away zone.
- **Price:** renewal grants Vendor no unilateral uplift right. Fees run off the Exhibit A/B schedule, Section 6 (p0047) freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year plus a best-rate cap, and Section 16 (p0081) requires a signed writing for any amendment, so the conditional price-cap element is not triggered.

Preferred-level trimmings only — no Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal and no express lesser-of-CPI-and-3% cap on any negotiated uplift — noted in the rationale, not redlined. No redline proposed.
